snippet.title: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker - Official Announcement Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2025
snippet.description: Welcome Tavernkeep! Meet Mariyam and learn about this character in this Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker announcement trailer for the upcoming D&D-inspired visual novel sequel. In Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker, you will run a cozy seaside tavern, meet adventurers, gather rumours and mix fate-altering drinks to stop dreams from twisting into nightmares. Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker will be available on PC and Nintendo Switch in 2025.
